name: 配信リスト作成の履歴
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE existing Lighthouse component LH03-0005「配信リスト作成の履歴」.
Priority: ORIGINAL Image1 governs source notice anatomy, spacing, proportions and fine details; Image2 our mock is secondary for Japanese content and broad placement only. Image3 is style guidance only, not content.
Create a compact centered system-history notice on pure white canvas: one white rounded rectangle with a fine neutral outline and an almost imperceptible soft shadow, logical250px wide44px high, within390x60px composition. Same balanced small insets and calm neutral grouping as original white broadcast-list creation notice.
Exact Japanese text on ONE line:「2人への配信リストを作成しました」.
Preserve actual count2 and all wording. Meiryo Regular logical12px/16px tracking0, neutral readable #526173, centered vertically and horizontally. Uniformly enlarge all dimensions for a sharp landscape3:1 output with the single notice centered and modest white margins. Keep the compact text; do not turn it into a bold heading.
Color evidence: original notice is white and neutral, distinguishing a system event from colored outgoing messages. Our mock incorrectly has mint fill and green text. Return to a white surface and coherent slate supporting text under the official system. No additional accent or forest-green button is needed because this is a passive recorded event.
No icons, checkmarks, avatars, dismiss action, time, badges, headers, explanatory copy, English, chat history, wallpaper or phone frame. The original and mock have no control within this notice; do not invent one. Complete Japanese glyphs, no clipping or wrapping. One component only.
reviewNotes: 原画像の白い中立なシステム履歴を最優先に、モックのミントと緑文字を白面・スレート文字へ修正。アクセントは受動履歴に不要なので省略。実画像を目視し、2人への配信リストを作成しましたの全文・数字2・1行・中央配置・細枠・穏やかな影、余計な操作や記号なしを確認。正確な書体計測・編集可能性・実配信・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
